name: io.github.tonyyang0504/jd_worldwide_open-mcp
description: JD Worldwide (京东全球购) + JD Open Platform (宙斯) (ecommerce suppliers): me, list_products, get_product,

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_JD_WORLDWIDE_OPEN_APP_KEY
environmentVariables.description: app_key of your JD Open Platform (宙斯/JOS) app, https://jos.jd.com/.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_JD_WORLDWIDE_OPEN_APP_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: appSecret of the same app; signs every call: upper(MD5(appSecret + sorted name+value of all parameters + appSecret)). Never sent on the wire.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_JD_WORLDWIDE_OPEN_ACCESS_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: The merchant's access_token from the JOS OAuth authorisation (https://jos.jd.com/commondoc?listId=32); renew it before it expires and update this value — the runtime does not refresh it.
